title: Build profiles in parallel for hmm queries
body:
build_pipeline constructs profiles serially for hmm queries. The par_iter path is commented out at search.rs:116-117 while sequence queries use par_iter. At 20,795 Pfam profiles this is likely most of the 9.2 s untimed setup gap on the MGnify run.

Find out why it was commented out, then restore it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text: On the mgy run pipeline build is 6.2 s, 1.3% of the run, the second largest serial item. Blocked on the libsail evaluation since it may replace the p7hmm parsing this touches.
